_comment: Policy boundaries for the dedicated service-email (Gmail) capability. FR-20260808-dedicated-service-email. Secrets are NEVER stored here — only policy toggles. Outbound is operator-gated: allow_outbound is the master switch (default false), and even when true a message is delivered only when the caller passes an explicit operator_approved=True argument to send_draft/send_message/connectivity_test. The connectivity-test recipient is supplied at runtime and is never persisted to this file, logs, or the FR ledger.
